record.question: To Justify the texts document on both sides of the margin, you have to press
options: Control key + J in PageMaker and Control key+ Shift key + J in Microsoft Word
Control key + Shift Key + J in PageMaker and Control + J in Microsoft Word
Alt. key + Control key + J in Page Maker and Alt key + J in Microsoft Word
Alt key + Shift Key + J in PageMaker and Alt key + Control Key + J in Microsoft Word
record.explanation: Full justification shortcut is Control+Shift+J in PageMaker and Control+J in Microsoft Word. Only option (b) gives this pairing as printed on page 9.
